text:
maria: Auditor pinged — they want a concise evidence bundle: recent RBAC modifications, approvals, KMS rotation proof, and any incident triage tied to role changes. We need to scope and inventory artifacts.

sam: What's the time window? auditor mentioned 'last 90 days'. Should we confirm exact dates?

auditor: 90 days is fine. We need: (1) a changelist of role edits/creations/deletes with diffs; (2) approval records (PRs/tickets/emails); (3) filtered audit logs showing the changes and any assume-role/access events; (4) KMS rotation manifest + verification that decrypts succeeded post-rotation.

maria: OK 90 days. Priority mapping: each role change must map to an approval artifact. Provide compact log samples, not the entire raw index.

alex: For logs, I'll produce a Splunk filtered CSV and a replay-friendly sample (1 hour condensed). Query to pull role-change events: ```index=infra (action=UpdateRole OR action=CreateRole OR action=DeleteRole OR action=AssumeRole) | table _time, user, action, roleName, requestId```

sam: KMS rotation data lives in our key-audit table. We also have an automated decrypt-check lambda that runs after rotation. Example invocation: ```aws lambda invoke --function-name verify-kms-rotation --payload '{"keyAlias":"alias/redwood-main","ciphertext":"<blob>"}' out.json```

alex: Sample sanitized log line: ```2025-06-11T17:22:03Z INFO user=ci-bot role=ci-service action=UpdateRole roleName=data-export requestId=req-7f3b```

jess: Packaging checklist for SOC2/ISO package: - control mapping CSV (control id -> artifact file) - RBAC diffs CSV with PR links - approval artifacts (redacted) - filtered audit log exports + one replay sample - KMS rotation manifest + decrypt test outputs - incident summary (if any) - README explaining redactions and sampling rationale

maria: I'll write the crosswalk README. Sam, can you extract PR->role diffs. Alex, export Splunk CSV + make the replay sample. Jess, confirm email/ticket redaction policy.

sam: I'll script diffs from infra repo and IaC snapshots. Example output row: `2025-05-02T15:10Z, iam/roles/data-export, change=policy_attachment, pr=https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/248`

alex: Splunk export ETA ~90m. For the replay sample I will include only events with role names present in the diffs and matching assume-role events. Command: ```splunk search "index=infra (action=AssumeRole OR action=UpdateRole)" | outputcsv rbac_sample.csv```

jess: Redaction policy: remove personal emails, replace with pseudonyms (uid:XXXX). Keep PR URLs but redact author emails and tokens. Document mapping in README.

maria: Also include incident triage evidence for any anomalous role activity. Query for alerts and link incident tickets referencing role names.

sam: There was an alert on 2025-06-11 where an external CI job attempted UpdateRole and failed MFA — ticket INT-321. I'll include ticket notes and relevant logs (truncated).

alex: I'll prepare a sanitized timeline and trace spans for that incident; include one screenshot of the timeline and exported spans (no secrets).

auditor: For the incident we need a clear timeline, responder names, actions taken, mitigation steps, and confirmation that no KMS keys or plaintext were exposed. A short signed statement from the oncall lead suffices.

oncall-bot: @maria assigned INT-321 to maria for evidence package (due 2025-07-10) :white_check_mark:

maria: Plan: produce one tarball: `evidence_bundle_2025-07-09.tar.gz` containing: `crosswalk.csv`, `rbac_diffs.csv`, `approval_artifacts/` (redacted), `logs/` (filtered CSVs + sample.log), `kms/rotation_manifest.txt`, `kms/decrypt_test_outputs.txt`, `incident/INT-321.md`, `README.md`.

sam: Auditor also wants reproducible decrypt tests showing both previous and rotated key versions can decrypt (controlled test). I'll include the test script and outputs.

alex: Note: never include private key material nor unredacted ciphertexts. Provide KMS metadata, rotation timestamps, and decrypt success logs only.

jess: I'll draft the cover letter referencing mapping to SOC2 A.9 and A.12 and ISO sections relevant to access control and cryptography.

maria: Timeline: artifacts ready 2025-07-09, redaction by 2025-07-10, upload to auditor SFTP 2025-07-11. Blockers?

sam: None; waiting on Splunk export.

alex: Export finished, packaging now. Will signal when tarball ready.

auditor: Please include MD5 checksum, manifest with file sizes, and a brief sampling rationale explaining why full raw logs aren't included.

maria: Will add those to README and manifest. Sam to add PR linking scripts used to create artifacts for auditor verification.

sam: Will open a small PR with scripts and point to the generated artifacts.

maria: Great. If anything unexpected surfaces, @channel escalate to me. :handshake:
